subject: Sandbox top-up & promo exit path for NorthStar Labs
messages:
From: Arielle Gomez <arielle@northstarlabs.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: contracts@northstarlabs.ai
Date: Mon, 16 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sandbox top-up & conversion path question

Hi Markus,

Quick intro — Arielle at NorthStar Labs. We’ve been running a small sandbox pilot with Redwood for six weeks and the team is seeing promising results on our summarization workflow. Usage is spiking and we’ll likely hit our free sandbox cap in ~10 days.

Two asks:
- Can we get a one-time top-up on the sandbox (roughly $10k-15k in credits) to finish the POC?
- If we convert to Dedicated after the pilot, is there any way to apply remaining promo credits or receive a conversion discount? Our legal team also asks about an "escape hatch" if the workload blows past projections.

We’re targeting a short Dedicated pilot (1–2 months) after the sandbox. Would be great to understand options so we can present numbers to our CFO this week.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call.

Arielle Gomez
Head of Platform
NorthStar Labs
[Attachment: sandbox-usage-apr2028.csv (CSV, 28KB)]

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Arielle Gomez <arielle@northstarlabs.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Apr 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sandbox top-up & conversion path question

Hi Arielle — great to hear the pilot is progressing. Thanks for the usage file, that helped.

Short answer: yes, we can structure a one-time sandbox top-up and we typically offer a conversion path, but it requires a small commercial exception and a short contract addendum. Proposed starting point (flexible):

- One-time sandbox top-up: $12,000 in promo credits (applies to sandbox billing only), expires 30 days after grant.
- Conversion incentive: if NorthStar signs a Dedicated commit >= $10k/month within 30 days of top-up, we’ll convert leftover promo value into a 15% credit against the first month’s Dedicated invoice (not a cash refund).
- Escape hatch: if monthly usage during the Dedicated pilot exceeds 3x the forecasted run-rate before the first billing cycle, we’ll pause auto-conversion and revert to pay-as-you-go at standard rates while we align on capacity.

I’ve attached a short milestone-action plan (MAP) that outlines acceptance criteria and go/no-go checkers. If this is acceptable, I’ll route to Sales Ops and Finance for a quick exception approval and get a draft addendum to your contracts team.

Proposed next step: 30-minute sync this week to confirm.

Best,
Markus Klein
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: NSL-MAP-v1.pdf (PDF, 42KB)]

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>

Subject: Fwd: Sandbox top-up & conversion path question — ask for exception

Team — forwarding Arielle's request. They want a one-time $12k sandbox top-up and the ability to convert leftover credits into a first-month Dedicated discount (15%) if they commit >= $10k/mo within 30 days. They also asked for an escape hatch if usage spikes.

Questions:
- Can Sales Ops approve a $12k promo top-up on the sandbox?
- Is the proposed conversion (promo -> 15% first month credit) something Finance will sign off on? We should include a rev-protection clause (i.e., cap the conversion credit at remaining promo value and require a 6-month minimum if converted).

Arielle included the usage CSV which I reviewed — looks like they’ll need the runway. Hoping for a quick thumbs from you all so we can move forward before their CFO meeting.

Looping in Sales Ops perspective. Quick thoughts:

- Approve a reduced top-up: $10,000 promo credits (sandbox only), expiry 30 days. This keeps exposure lower than $12k while still giving runway.
- Conversion path: offer conversion of remaining promo balance into a billing credit up to the remaining promo value, capped at $10k, applied only to the first Dedicated invoice. In exchange require a signed 6-month minimum at the committed rate (protects revenue).
- Escape hatch: we can include a temporary overage buffer (up to 50% of forecast) during the first month, after which auto-scaling will bill at standard rates. If they exceed 3x forecast we pause the discount and trigger an EPD (Engineering + Product + Delivery) review.

If Finance (Ben) is comfortable, I’ll prepare the addendum doc and the MAP language for the deal record. Also recommend a 15% list-price uplift for the Dedicated commitment to compensate for the promo (we can discount that back to the committed rate later).

Marissa
Sr. Sales Ops Manager

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Apr 2028 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Sandbox top-up & conversion path question — finance approval

Thanks for the write-up. Finance is OK to approve the exception with these constraints:

1) Top-up capped at $10,000 and must be time-limited (30 days).
2) Conversion credit is allowed but capped to remaining promo value and only applied to the first Dedicated invoice. No cash refunds.
3) Conversion requires a signed addendum with a minimum 6-month financial commitment at the stated committed rate.
4) If actual usage exceeds the pilot forecast by >300% before the first billing cycle, conversion rights are voided and normal billing applies.
5) Sales must notify Billing to create a dedicated one-off credit line; include tax code handling in the contract addendum.

Once Sales Ops drafts the addendum I’ll greenlight. Good to move quickly given their CFO timeline.

Ben Carter
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Arielle Gomez <arielle@northstarlabs.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, contracts@northstarlabs.ai
Date: Thu, 19 Apr 2028 16:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sandbox top-up & conversion path question — proposed terms

Arielle — thanks for the patience. Team has approved an exception with the following final terms:

1) One-time sandbox top-up: $10,000 in promo credits (sandbox billing only). Credits expire 30 days after issuance.
2) Conversion incentive: if NorthStar signs a Dedicated commitment >= $10k/month and executes the addendum within 30 days of the top-up, remaining promo credits (if any) will convert into a billing credit applied to the first Dedicated invoice, capped at $10k. This is not refundable cash.
3) Minimums & protections: conversion requires a 6-month minimum at the committed rate. If usage exceeds 3x forecast before the first billing cycle, conversion is voided and standard rates apply.
4) Operational: we’ll provision a one-off credit line through Billing and share a contract addendum for signatures. Sales Ops (Marissa) will send the addendum; Ben will confirm tax handling.

Next steps: I’ll push the MAP and addendum now. Can we schedule a 30-minute handoff with your solutions engineer and our EPD ops to agree on the runbook (tomorrow or Friday)?

Cheers,
Markus Klein
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
